summary.en: A symbolic system some people use for self-description. In OHC it makes no claim to empirical validity, and its results are frame-relative.
summary.ru: Символическая система, которой некоторые люди пользуются для самоописания. В OHC она не претендует на эмпирическую обоснованность, а её результаты относятся только к этой рамке.

assumptions: the frame is meaningful to the person who chose it
the frame makes no empirical claim in OHC
mentalModel.howChangeHappens: Not addressed by OHC; the person decides how the frame is used.

dont: treat frame attributes as facts about the person
present a frame attribute, or anything read from it, as an empirical trait or a prediction

doesNotClaim: anything about compatibility with other people
mentalModel.summary: A chart computed from birth data offers a symbolic system the person may use for self-description.
mentalModel.unitOfAnalysis: the person's own use of the system's terms
attendsTo: how the person uses the system's terms
what it helps the person put into words
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Use the system's terms only as the person's chosen language; use the generic name only; never present it as fact or prediction.
exploratoryQuestions: How does this language help you describe your experience?
helperMustNot: map chart attributes to any empirical construct
riskNotes: Birth date, time and place identify a person
Frames tied to spiritual practice may reveal beliefs

toolkit.name: Chart from birth data
toolkit.description: A chart computed from birth data, with the engine and its version recorded.

representations.description: Type, authority, profile and centres as frame attributes, with the engine and version used.

suggestionRequires: the person brought up the frame themselves

citations.ref: Court of Florence, judgment of 3 June 2020
citations.note: IP: no copyright in the system itself
IP: 'MYBODYGRAPH HUMAN DESIGN' registered 11 Mar 2025; owner Jovian Archive Media Pte. Ltd.
IP: both applications for 'THE HUMAN DESIGN SYSTEM' were abandoned

evidence.notes: No empirical study is relied on; the frame makes no empirical claim in OHC. The citations above concern IP only.

supports: self-description in a symbolic language the person chose
doesNotEstablish: any trait, state or behaviour of the person

marks.notice: US Reg. No. 7724676 (11 Mar 2025). Not used by OHC.

restrictions: use the generic term only; never the registered composite mark
